Ready for the maintainer to merge. A DELTA sync (side/path-kernel), and the five hand-resolved hunks are exactly "both sides kept".

## What looks good

- The PR replays cleanly: the three merges (main `392980120`, side/path-kernel `500f40256`, main `6898b02ea`) replayed from `21fd9e57d` reproduce the head tree byte-for-byte (`9f578a2a98dc0050b0c401db7b9c3a402af845bd`).
- The hand edits are only the five list hunks; no logic changed on either side.
- The author's gates are green on this head: batch `1019/0`, clippy, example catalog (50 + 1 + 1), light `7/0`, heavy motion and app `117/0`, xtask `cargo test -p xtask`.

## Results

Built locally in the review worktree (not the release runner; no runner verdict).

- `cargo test -p xtask` (this head): ok, exit 0. Last suite binaries: script `7 passed`, release_site_tests `3 passed`, review_artifacts `3 passed`.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` (this head): ok, no warnings.
- The author's full batch gate on this head: `1019/0`, with `clippy -D warnings` ok, `app suites: example_catalog` 50 passed + 4 ignored, `example_catalog_adaptive` 1, `example_catalog_edge_work` 1, `site tests` SKIP (zola, node missing).
- Heavy, motion and app lanes (author, this head): `117/0`; the four known-fail markers red as expected (motion #1950 x2, app #1950, app #2849).
- Light lane (author, this head): `7/0`.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: not re-run by me; the author's green light run on this exact head is recorded. No example catalog re-run needed for a list-only sync.

## Trial merge

Replayed the three merges from `side/path-kernel` at `21fd9e57d` onto a fresh worktree, keeping both sides of each hunk, and compared the final tree to the PR head. Identical. The five hunks:

1. `Cargo.toml` (merge 1): workspace members hold `crates/pathkernel` (side) and `crates/ui-kit` (main, #4394) (line 4); the `[workspace.dependencies]` block keeps `camcraft-pathkernel` and `camcraft-ui-kit` (lines 20, 22).
2. `xtask/src/plan.rs` (merge 1): `BATCH_CRATES`, `ALL_CRATES` and `CLIPPY` hold `pathkernel` and `ui-kit` (lines 19-25).
3. `xtask/src/heavy_plan_tests.rs` (merge 1): the side pins (geometry reach incl. `pathkernel`; `reach["pathkernel"]` set, line 48-49) and main's rule (kernel reaches every crate but `gpu` and `ui-kit`; `all_but_gpu` filter) are both kept (lines 50-51).
4. `xtask/src/step_tests.rs` (merge 1): the pinned list holds `pathkernel` and `ui-kit` (line 114).
5. `xtask/src/tests.rs` (merge 3): the clippy step name keeps `camcraft-pathkernel` and is now the second-last batch step (main's #4133 `site tests` step is last) (line 198); the release side keeps main's site-step comment, `+ 1 + 2` formula and `r[r.len() - 3]` assertion (lines 204-207).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes

- The PR does not include the post-gate move of `main` to `2394b5ad1`. That is expected; the base of this PR is what the PR says.
- The batch `site tests` step is SKIP because the zola and node tools are absent on this machine. It is not a pass and not a failure for this review either.
- The author's heavy run did not include the kernel lane; this DELTA does not touch the kernel (no kernel code in this diff), so no heavy step is needed for this review.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
